wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 10-002 wires the shared combat primitives via one src/vanilla facade (wireDamageAndTargeting.ts) re-exporting the read-only ai/targeting (checkSight/lookForPlayers/checkMeleeRange/checkMissileRange + MISSILE_* cutoffs/clamps), ai/soundPropagation (createSoundState/noiseAlert), and world/radiusAttack (radiusAttack). VANILLA_DAMAGE_TARGETING_INVARIANTS pins five rules (LOS-gated target acquisition; allaround FOV gate; fixed melee/missile cutoffs + per-archetype clamps; distance-falloff radius attack; sound-line flood-fill noiseAlert). The focused test exercises the real createSoundState allocation, the MISSILE_* constants, the frozen manifest, the multi-line-tolerant ../-filtered specifier set, and dynamic same-reference identity, keeping the test inventory-neutral. No const enums re-exported (verbatimModuleSyntax). This step became eligible only after the cb296d9 fix removed the spurious 09-008<->10-002 prerequisite cycle.
